batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c DB Ravi Teja b A Mishra

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b PP Ojha

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b DW Steyn

batting.name: S Sohal
batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b Iqbal Abdulla

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b Iqbal Abdulla

balls.text: slower one and Yusuf picked it really late, tried to clear square leg but sneaked a leg bye in the end
Steyn errs in length again, another full toss on middle, Yusuf just flicks it over square leg for a boundary, was aiming for the yorker but one gone bad
slower one and Tiwary times it a little too well in the end, it's a chip but beautifully timed one, landed straight in the hands of deep cover where Shikhar Dhawan took it comfortably
full toss on middle, there is a deep midwicket in place and this goes straight to him
slower one as he saw him make room, Tiwary pushed it towards point for a single
full toss and Manoj Tiwary cashes in, makes a bit of room and smacks him over midwicket for a one bounce four
powerfully struck, just a fraction short on the off stump, picks the length early and thumps it past a diving midwicket for four more
banged in short on the off, tried to pull it but couldn't connect, good delivery
pitched outside off, Yusuf makes room and slices it over point, Chipli runs to his left from deep point and drags it just inside the ropes, just a couple in the end
nicely hit but not as nicely as he would have wanted, length ball and he got under it but failed to clear long-on, got to him on the bounce
back of a length on middle, Yusuf swivels to play it down fine, manages only a leg bye in the end

dropped, though it wouldn't be entirely fair to call it that, didn't pick the slower one did Yusuf, went for a mighty swing over midwicket, got a top edge, Dhawan ran yards in from deep square leg and dived forward but he appeared to have overrun it and never got his hands to it in the end, two more
low full toss on the off, drilled towards long-off, keeps the strike
length ball outside off, tries to cream that through the covers, gets an inside edge past the keeper for a couple more
pushes it fuller attempting the yorker, driven down towards long-on for a single
massive! Slower one bowled short outside off and Manoj Tiwary cashes in, stays his ground and clobbers it miles into the stands behind deep midwicket
good length outside off, caresses it through the covers for a single
slower one bowled outside leg just as he saw the batsman making room, tries to tickle it fine, steals a leg bye in the end
ooh, beamer, struck on the shoulder, Christian immediately apologised, called a no-ball for height
shortish ball, murdered by Yusuf Pathan, stands tall and absolutely clobbers the ball over long-on for six, ends up an expensive over for Deccan
Ishant can't finish off what was a decent over, he sprays a high no-ball on legstump, easily above waist high, helped along to fine leg, Ishant apologises
Tiwary sets himself up for the big heave, Ishant spots that and slips in the bouncer outside off, Tiwary can't get bat on it
this time it is Yusuf who plays it uppishly towards deep midwicket, much more controlled shot this, again bounces a few yards short of the fielder
Ishant sticks to the same length, Tiwary can't get hold of the pull, completely mis-hit, lands well short of deep midwicket
another short ball, muscled with a flat bat past midwicket, wide long-on comes across to collect that
shortish ball outside off, Tiwary slaps it towards deep backward point, Ojha races across from third man to cut it off
outside off, pushed towards extra cover for a single, Tiwary's strike-rate has quickly climbed to close to a run-a-ball
follows it up with another beautiful hit, again he moves past legstump, this was full from Steyn, Tiwary drives it inside-out past extra cover for four

shortish from Steyn, what a response from Tiwary, he skips towards leg and swings his bat at it, sends it to a one-bounce four to third man, Tiwary has had a bit of struggle today, this was superb from him
Tiwary wants to join the party, looks to club the ball over long-on, he misses, that was short of a length ball that sailed over the stumps
length ball on off, just moves away a touch, outside edged towards point by Yusuf
Tiwary does the sensible thing, chopping the ball to cover for a single that brings Yusuf on strike

bang! power from Yusuf, that was an awesome hit, barely had any elevation, flew flat and long, wide outside off, Yusuf brutalised it over wide long-off for a six to give Deccan something to ponder during the strategic time-out

Another drop, "I hit you miss," Yusuf says, he wanted to clobber this one over long-on, it was a regulation catch for Dan Christian who was stationed at the boundary, was an overhead catch he should have taken, instead he flubs it, and the ball bounces over for four, Mishra's misery compounds
slapped towards point by Yusuf
hustles straight through, Yusuf get back in the crease and tucks the ball towards deep midwicket, great running from Tiwary to pinch the second
punched down towards long-on for a single
googly to start, pitching outside off and homing in on the stumps, Tiwary squeezes it towards point
hello massive, Yusuf does what he does best, a length ball,  swing of the arms from Yusuf and that ball has been put into orbit, flies way over the long-on boundary
Tiwary hurries out of the crease once more, jabs the ball towards long-on for a single
fired down the leg side, off the pads towards short fine leg
a touch short from Ojha, Tiwary skates out and heaves the ball towards mid-on
punched off the front foot towards mid-off

Dropped, that's a big miss, Yusuf survives, a swipe towards deep midwicket and Mishra should have taken that, it wasn't that difficult, he got under that one near the rope, and let it slip through his fingers
superb over from Mishra, just three off it, Tiwary defends the final ball towards cover off the front foot
shortish this time, carved towards point, just a single
fullish ball just outside off, batsman yorks himself as he looks to hammer the ball over long-on
pushes it towards mid-on for another single, Deccan putting the brakes on here
slightly overpitched outside off, driven firmly off the front foot towards extra cover
length ball pitching on middle, clipped to the leg side
inside-edged on to the pad off the front foot
gets well forward and defends it towards cover

Gambhir's gone now! two massive wickets gone in quick succession, Gambhir looks to dab the ball towards short third man, backs away to play the shot, he can't get enough bat on it, nicks it to the keeper
trotted out and punches it over the bowler's head for a boundary, lovely to watch
Yusuf Pathan sweeps, that stroke was played with one hand, flies to fine leg
usuf Pathan gets forward and defends it down the track

that's a big wicket, Kallis advances down the track, Mishra shortens the length, Kallis doesn't reach the pitch of the ball, he tries to go through with the lofted shot, he can't get enough power behind the shot, holes out to wide long-off
Paddled down to short fine
Pushed past point
Wide down the leg side
Slapped towards deep cover
floats it full on the off, driven down the ground to long-off for a single
three more, they are working him around well, payed very late once again, nudged it behind short third man and it had enough legs on it to fetch them three
quicker through the air, short on the off, chopped behind point for a single
Kallis comes down the track and lofts that wide of long-on for a couple of runs
made room and slapped it towards deep extra cover for a single
Ojha lands that on middle and leg, turned away past square leg for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, opens the face at the last moment to take a single to third man
slower one bowled short outside off, run down to third man for a single
similar delivery, just a little wider, cut down towards third man for a single
dropped, but a difficult one, short and wide and got a thick edge as he went for the cut, Sanga couldn't hold on
smashed! Short and he seizes the length early, stays in his crease and pulls it away fiercely over the midwicket boundary
angling it towards middle, gets across and turns it wide of midwicket for a single
much slower through the air, waits for it turn in, dabs it behind short third for a couple of runs, slightly expensive start for Ojha
short and cuts, uppishly but it lands just short of the fielder placed at point
bowls it short outside off, chops it down towards point
short on middle, rocks back and jabs it past midwicket for a couple more in the deep, Chipli does well diving full length
short, waits for it to turn in does Gambhir, makes room and slashes it past the diving point for a boundary
angles it short on middle and leg, worked away past square leg for a single
turned away off the back foot past square leg for a single
kept a little low, short of a good length, punched it wide of the bowler, Dhawan dived full length to his right to save the single
steps out of the crease and drags it towards long-on for one more
pitched up on middle and off, makes a bit of room and crunches it to extra cover
landing on middle and off, gets across and dabs it into the leg side for a single
tossed up, bowled full outside off, driven down towards long-off for a single
shortish outside off, run down to third man for a single
Gambhir begins confidently too, was the slower one again, landed on a length outside off, he just chipped it over extra cover for a boundary

bowled'im! Got him with the slower one, targeting leg stump this time and was the slower offcutter, Morgan had made his mind up, came down the track and tried to launch him over long-on much like he had done earlier in the innings, but this was a slower delivery and he was through with the shot a touch too early, missed and the leg stump is out of the ground
much improved over from Christian, lands full on the off, pushed away towards extra cover
slower one this time, the offcutter, Morgan is a little late on his attempted cut there, picks it but doesn't play it in time
will feel he missed out there will Morgan, short and wide and tried to clear point, missed
resumes with a wide, saw Morgan charging out and slipped it well wide outside off
backed himself to go for that and it seemed as though the shot was on, short and wide and charged out to slash that over point, missed
slower one again, slightly short this time, was the attempted offcutter, Kallis picked it late and was trying to dab it past Sangakkara but couldn't make contact
slower one bowled short outside off, plays it away towards point
pulled away, there isn't an awful amount of bounce on this pitch and Kallis has no trouble dispatching that, short outside off and he gets into position early to thwack it past mid-on and midwicket
short of a good length, rocks back and punches it to point
gift ball there from Ishant, short and wide and at the right height for Kallis who slashes it to the deep point boundary, Ojha at third man isn't the quickest and had no chance
slower one this time from Steyn, steps out and has to reach for it in the end, pushes it towards extra cover
banged it short on leg, Morgan failed to take full toll, mistiming a pull behind square for a couple of runs
goodish length on the off, pushes it firmly in front of Sohal at mid-off for a quick run
shortish on the off, makes a hint of room and opens the face to play it towards third man for a single
short and wide but not wide enough for Morgan to execute the cut, was aiming hard at point but missed
short of a good length on the off, drops it behind point for a single
mistimed, slightly short and he tried to cream that past cover, sneaked a quick single in the end

edged and over the keeper, short and wide, Kallis made room and simultaneously came down the track, tried to upper cut that over third man, got a thick edge and it evaded Sangakkara's jump to race for a boundary
Again uncharacteristic from Kallis, offers a bit of width, he charges down the track and tries to murder that through the off side but is nowhere near it
short of a good length on the off, rocks back and punches it towards point
hits the pitch hard, on middle and leg, turns it towards square leg
short of a good length on middle and leg, gets back and turns it past midwicket for a single
slightly short on middle and leg, gets on the back foot and works it to midwicket
lovely stuff, follows up that rather uncharacteristic swing with a text-book drive between extra cover and mid-off, bowled on a good length and he just eased it through the line
short of a good length outside off, backs away to smash it through point, slashes hard but misses as it moves away
short outside off and Kallis shapes up to play the pull, misses, was targeting midwicket there
back of a length outside off and nips away, leaves it be
short of a good length on the off, rocks back and knocks it down into the leg side
slightly short on the off, rocks on the back foot and drops it in front of point
slightly short outside off, runs it down towards third man for a single
leaving the left hander there, short of a good length and nips away, Morgan shoulders arms this time
short and wide, too wide, Morgan thinks of chasing it but gives it up at the last moment, called a wide
held it back a hint did Christian, lands on a good length, steps forward and defends it soundly into the off side
massive, length ball on the off stump and Morgan cashes in, takes a couple of steps down the track and deposits it over the long-on boundary, nice clean strike
down the leg side, lands on a good length outside leg, tries to tickle it fine, misses, given a wide

run-out appeal, what a start, Morgan appeared to be struggling there, short of a good length outside off, cut it behind point, completed the first one easily, took a chance on the throw for the second, dived full length and Steyn returned an accurate throw, except it was a touch high. It gave Morgan that extra moment to just drag it in with the dive, he's safe, eventful start
he picks it from a length and plays it to midwicket for a single to end it all
low full toss outside off, steered wide of point for just a single
banged in short on middle, called a wide, too high
short on the off, comes down the track and swings it over midwicket for a couple of runs, Unadkat, who has done nothing but field this game, slides and keeps them to two
tries to play the scoop, shuffles across to play it over short fine, misses, not called a wide
another one heading towards the blockhole, pushed towards long-on for a single, it's over
full on middle and leg, digs it out towards midwicket for just the single
full on the off, pushed past extra cover for just the single
low full toss on middle, driven towards long-on for a single
full and wide and reaches for it, fails to get to it, a dot ball
four more, bowled on a length and he picks it up well, making room and striking it meatily over extra cover for another one
full toss and a consequent boundary but a little too late, punched over extra cover to find the gap
Lee aims for the blockhole, dug out into the leg side for a single
slower one bowled short on leg stump, tries to help it on its way fine, just gets a single
swings and misses, fullish outside off and Mishra fails to connect
slashes hard, gets a thick outside edge and Lee tries his best to compensate for those two fours he conceded, diving full length to his left to save a couple
Deccan are sliding here, Dhawan walked way too across, Kallis targeted off stump, tried to clip it fine, missed and the off stump was sent on its way.
length ball outside off, struck hard by Chipli but finds long-off, just a single
mistimed pull again, full toss on leg stump, just a single wide of square leg
bowled'im, it's fast and straight, full on the off, almost a yorker, Ravi Teja swings across the line to that 147kph delivery, it's too quick for him, misses and the stumps are splayed
accurate stuff, aiming for the yorker and almost succeeds, manages to dig it out into the leg side and races back for the second
full toss and he fails to cash in, mistimes a pull past midwicket for just a single
tries to crash it through the off side, gets an inside edge onto his pads, quick single taken
low full toss on the off, driven hard down the ground to long-off for a single
yorker on the off, dug out wide of point where there's a fumble and he completes his fifty with a single, the misfield allows him to run back for the second as well
the extra ball, as a result of the lapse off the first ball, proves costly. Slower ball bowled short and it's hammered past the covers for a boundary
full and he moves well across to work it away through the leg side and fails in the process, a dot ball
good over from Balaji so far, low full toss, Ravi punches it past midwicket for a couple more in the deep
brilliantly fielded by Lee this time, full on the pads and it's glanced down fine, Lee dives to his right and covers it well to save three runs
short, slow and way too wide, Ravi chases it and slashes it on the bounce to deep point, just a single
full toss again and Dhawan crashes it through the off side but there is cover in the deep, just a single
full toss on the off, pushed gently towards long-on for a single. This has been given a no-ball as there are more fielders than allowed outside the circle
full delivery outside off, drops it in front of cover to sneak in a quick single
lovely strike from Ravi Teja, Deccan are stepping up, gets to the pitch and lofts him over his head, Lee can't reach this one, running from long-on
Dhawan comes down the track, takes it from a length and drives it down to deep midwicket for a single
drops it in front of point to give his more dominant partner the strike
paddled wide of short fine for a quick single

Lee fumbles for the second time, a mistake again, low full toss and it's swatted hard down the ground, Lee at long-off runs to his left and dives, appears to have it covered, but lets it through in the end to concede another four
pushes it towards extra cover, Ravi wants the single but Dhawan rightly sends him back
drags it from outside off to sweep it towards deep square leg
worked away through square leg for a single this time
fires it short on the off, moves away and chops it behind point for a couple more
fires it quick on middle, gets a leading edge as he tries to close the face, a single wide of extra cover

Jaidev Unadkat takes an absolute blinder, but he's tripped over the ropes in the process. Slower one and Dhawan slog-swept it and Unadkat, standing on the edge of the ropes at the deep midwicket boundary timed his jump to perfection and plucked it out with his left hand but couldn't hold his balance and fell over. Brilliant effort nevertheless
short of a good length outside off, steered towards point to steal a quick single
short and he pulls it away smartly on the bounce to deep square leg for a single
floating it full on middle, worked away into the deep towards wide long-on for a single
yorker on middle, dug out towards long-off for one more, the pressure grows
the legcutter, pushed it into the vacant midwicket region for a single
slightly short on middle, comes down the track and plays it back to the bowler
quicker through the air, drops it in front of short third man for a single
slightly short on the off, gets on the back foot and plays it towards midwicket
fired it just outside leg, tried to sweep it fine, missed, called a wide
another short delivery, quicker through the air, pulled to square leg for a single
a boundary, a bit of a relief, was a long hop, rocked back and pulled it between long-on and deep midwicket for a boundary
Yusuf bowled that just short of a good length but Dhawan came down the track and played it to long-off for a single
slower one on middle, gets on the back foot to play it to square leg with his team's hopes fading

Given out lbw and Christian is upset! Bhatia slipped in the slower one again, was the legcutter again on middle and off, Christian tried to drive that through the line, got an inside edge and was struck in line but you can't give those out. The umpire didn't notice the deflection, Deccan are in big trouble now
the offcutter this time, pitched up on the off, driven to long-off for a single
good length on the off, gets forward and pushes it past the bowler
was the back of the hand legcutter, Christian steps forward and defends him towards cover

bowled'im! Cameron was reaching for the summit there, trying to dispatch it over midwicket and out of Hyderabad, was a massive swing but he failed to pick the slower one from Bhatia, was into the shot too early, partly out of desperation, and got an inside edge onto the stumps. A slow legcutter it was
pushed down the ground towards long-off for a single to keep strike
floating it on middle and off, gets across and tried to sweep it square, struck on the pads and there's an appeal but it was outside the line, moreover there was some bat involved
a single, comes down the track and whips him past square leg for a single
back of a length on middle, pushed back to the bowler, is there a big shot round the corner?
slightly short on the off, punched back towards the bowler and Yusuf does well to dive to his right and save the single
angling it towards middle from round the wicket, turned away into the leg side for a single
slower one bowled slightly short on the off, jabs it towards deep midwicket for a single to keep strike
played towards long-on for a single
misfield by Lee, you don't see that often, was a juicy full toss, White drives it meatily down the ground and Lee, running to his left from long-on, fumbles to allow it to roll over the ropes
slower one bowled slightly short on leg stump, punched past midwicket for a single
full toss and Dhawan closes the face early to swat it wide of square leg, it's mistimed, a powerful throw at the non-striker's end and Tiwary backs up well diving to his left
slower one bowled on  a good length on middle and leg, tickled towards short fine leg
takes it from a length and drives it down to long-off for a single
flighted on middle, not much turn, appeared to hold its line, played it firmly back to the bowler
lands it full on leg stump, tickled past square leg for a single
the paddle up to use by Cameron White now, plays it wide of short fine for three more, delicately done
attempting the shot again, tried to reverse-slap it to point, seemed as though there was a bit of an under-edge that the wicketkeeper failed to get his hands on, it's given byes though
nicely done, shortish outside off and he plays the reverse-sweep, well enough to beat short third man to the ropes
slower one bowled on the full on the off stump, driven straight to extra cover
low full toss on middle, aiming to get it in the blockhole, pushed back to the bowler
paddled, on middle and he turns it wide of fine leg for a couple of runs
slower one bowled on a length on middle and leg, turned towards square leg
tapped it just wide of point to race through for a single
Dhawan drives that down the ground to long-off for a single
flighted on middle, defended watchfully towards extra cover

Abdulla's having a ball, did that stop on Sangakkara? On middle and off, Sangakkara got forward and across and just chipped it towards Kallis at midwicket, the easiest of catches. Deccan in a bit of trouble now.
plays his favourite cover drive on a bent knee but straight to extra cover this time
Abdulla fires it short outside off and gets his reward, Sohal made room for the umpteenth time and cut it straight to Morgan at cover point where he took it easily
ooh, he's lucky, tossed up outside off, makes room and gets a thick outside edge as he tries to play it over extra cover, it just evades point
Abdulla bowls it flat on leg stump, Dhawan charges down and plays it down to long-on
in the channel outside off from round the wicket, tapped into the off side for another comfortable single
goodish length outside off, gets forward and taps it down towards point
goodish length outside off, tried to punch it past cover, got an inside edge onto the pads and sneaked a quick single
poor delivery with the fine leg up, angling in towards middle and leg from wide of the crease, Sohal gets back and tickles it to the fine-leg boundary
slower one bowled on a good length, pushes it firmly wide of mid-off for a quick single
pitches it up outside off and Dhawan shapes up for a drive, mistimes it to extra cover
comes down the track and drives it towards mid-off for a quick single

five runs, mistimed a swipe to mid-on where Rajat Bhatia fielded it on the bounce and tried to throw down the stumps at the non-striker's end, Sohal was gone had it hit as he didn't even try to ground his bat, so a missed run-out. Add to that the fact that there was no one backing up
down the leg side, quicker through the air, gets a bit of bat on it as he tries to turn it fine, gets a couple wide of short fine
floating it on the off stump, drives it down towards long-on for a single
angling towards middle and leg, turned through midwicket for an easy single
fiercely cut, off the front foot, saw the width and played it hard wide of point, third man had no chance
poor ball from Lee, banged it short on leg stump and Dhawan got into position quickly to play it down to the fine-leg boundary
nicely timed by Dhawan, fullish, driven through the line to mid-off where Gambhir fields well diving to his left and keeping them down to nothing
short of a good length on middle, turned it down wide of fine leg for a quick couple of runs
aiming for th yorker again but it turns out to be a low full toss, Sohal makes room and canes that towards deep point for a single
yorker from Lee, fired it at 147.7kph, Sohal moved away as expected and failed to break his bat down in time, just missed leg

thick outside edge again but this was as he was trying to play straight, Balaji bowled it on middle and off from wide of the crease and Sohal tried to defend it off the back foot, it moved away a hint to take the outside edge
edged, Balaji drops it slightly short outside off and Sohail, predictably, slashes hard, gets a thick edge to beat third man to the boundary
tries to go downtown, fullish outside off, made room to launch it over mid-off, made no contact, the ball held its line
short and wide, makes room to play the cut, misses, just went over the stumps, he made it seem wide by making so much room
short of a good length outside off, mistimes a cut and plays it to extra cover instead
width offered by Balaji and Sohal makes full use, makes room and slices it over point for a boundary, much slower is Balaji and the more confident is Sohal
fullish on the off, pushed it towards mid-off, good start from Lee
made room to that shortish delivery and got a thick outside edge towards third man as he tried to slash it
moved away and Sohal's footwork has gone awry there, played from the crease to that one and fished for it as it nipped away, was beaten
back of a length on middle, Sohal moved back to turn it square, was struck high on the pads, the thighs infact, pacy stuff from Lee
nicely driven, pitched p on the off, pushed towards cover point where Morgan fumbled while throwing but there was no damage done
kept a little low and moved away, Sohal was pushed onto the back foot and he played inside the line to that one, was beaten
